profile.headline: Web Developer
profile.summary:
Accomplished Web Developer and Marketing professional with 8 years of proven experience
in planning, coordinating, project management, and developing online content and marketing
policies. Broad-based background encompasses exceptional work ethic and commitment to
business and organizational objectives.

Seeking a full-time, part-time, or contract position that offers professional challenges utilizing
problem-solving skills, time management, and interpersonal skills.

I am confident my educational background and 8 years of experience in web development, marketing, and email campaigns for various small to mid-sized businesses throughout the Washington metro area is an asset.

I am proficient in the use of WordPress, Adobe Suite, Microsoft Office, Google Ads, Facebook Business Suite, and Google Analytics. I am also experienced in the use of customer data platforms like Blueconic, Salesforce, and Adobe Experience Manager to create sales funnels to track customer journeys on websites. I have marketing agency experience and collaborated with marketing and production managers, including company executives to create user-friendly web content and target specific audiences to increase website traffic and promote company brands. I also worked with third-party vendors and providers using Javascript and API integration to activate and enable custom functionality on client websites.

positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
positions.description: Skills: Customer Relationship Management (CRM) · Project Management · Website Administration

positions.title: Marketing & Digital Projects Manager
positions.description:
1. Responsible for all aspects of website building and maintenance of all 5
company websites including e-commerce. Marketing and email campaign
planning, creation, design, and implementation of SEO optimization efforts.

2. Promote company online presence through the use of blogging on social
media platforms, Google, and Facebook Ads. Review campaign returns
through the use of web analytical tools including Google Analytics to analyze
and further customize and refocus marketing campaign efforts.

3. Conduct site audits via online tools such as Moz, SEMRush, and Google
Core vitals to understand gaps in website health including site speed, and
project-managed the solutions. Ensure all websites meet all ADA and 508
compatibility standards.

4. Fly drones over demolition sites to capture before and after imagery for
use in promotional advertising to showcase company capability in the
industrial and environmental demolition space.

5. Create monthly reports in the Asana Project Management system on
Marketing and Advertising budgets to review ROI. Provide information on
new marketing channels, technology, and software including possible
adoption and implementation.

positions.title: Lead B2B Web Support Manager
positions.description:
1. Monitored and resolved incoming web support tickets utilizing enterprise Trello and Jira Service Management for ticketing, issue tracking, and reporting from client automotive dealer network. Prioritized web support requests and assigned them to support personnel in order of priority and urgency. Responsibilities
included direct interaction with dealer clients for ticket and service request clarifications. 

2. Resolved critical issues related to dealer inventory feed to websites, updated dealer websites, continuous optimization of websites for responsive and mobile display, created landing pages, banners, and sales funnels.

3. Updated dealer finance terms on inventory by utilizing SQL scripting and rules engine software across different vehicle manufacturers, brands, and various trim levels.

4. Worked with dealer-contracted third-party software providers and implemented custom functionality through the use of scripting (JavaScript) and API integration.

5. Built dealership automotive websites and integrated inventory with WordPress. Implemented marketing campaigns and integrated tracking solutions (Google Tag, Facebook Pixel, Hotjar) across multiple social media channels. Conducted weekly and monthly site audits to gauge site health and
implemented Google core vitals to improve SEO.

6. Created monthly reports via the use of project management tools including QuickBase and Jira Service Management to review problem areas and project-managed the solutions.

7. Created company knowledgebase to store proven website and service resolution steps.

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer and Online Marketing Specialist
positions.description:
1. Consulted, designed, and built websites including eCommerce for clients. Created online marketing campaigns and promotions via social media and Google and Facebook Ads.

2 Submitted websites to search engines including google, bing, MSN, yahoo, and optimized websites for Search Engines.

3. Designed marketing materials including flyers, brochures and presentations to promote client businesses.

4. Designed and built online learning management systems via the use of WordPress, Blackbaud, and Moodle.

5. Setup and manage Social media accounts on behalf of clients. Posted blogs with links back to client websites.

6. Analyzed campaign results using Google Analytics and advised on best practices for online marketing with clients.
